name: @mandate/judge-demo
description: Buildathon Milestone A: the judge-facing Mandate demo. A thin, additive orchestration layer over the frozen Portfolio Mandate (Phase 7F-7F.3) that runs the real protocol once, offline and deterministically, and turns what it returned into a versioned event transcript (MANDATE_JUDGE_DEMO.V1) for UI playback. Presentation only: it holds no authority and changes no protocol semantics.
